definitions.explanation: A train or bus that skips some stops to provide faster service.

examples.japanese: {急行|きゅうこう}で{行|い}けば{早|はや}く{着|つ}きます。
examples.english: If you take the express, you'll arrive quickly.

examples.japanese: この{駅|えき}には{急行|きゅうこう}は{止|と}まりません。
examples.english: The express doesn't stop at this station.

notes:
Japanese train types from slowest to fastest typically include:
- {普通|ふつう}/{各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ} - local (stops at all stations)
- {快速|かいそく} - rapid
- {急行|きゅうこう} - express
- {特急|とっきゅう} - limited express
